name: Grafted Brothers

Actions.name: Multiattack
Actions.text: The brothers makes two Fist attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Stolen Swing.

Actions.name: Fist
Actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +8, reach 10 ft. 31 (6d8 + 4) Bludgeoning damage.

Actions.name: Stolen Swing
Actions.text: *Dexterity Saving Throw*: DC 15, each creature in a 30-foot Cone. *Failure:* The target has the Prone condition.

Traits.name: Berserk
Traits.text: Whenever the brothers starts its turn Bloodied, roll 1d6. On a 6, the brothers goes berserk. On each of its turns while berserk, the brothers attacks the nearest creature it can see. If no creature is near enough to move to and attack, the brothers attacks an object. Once the brothers goes berserk, it remains so until it is destroyed or it is no longer Bloodied.
Traits.expresses: two brothers arguing over each swing
Traits.expressedQuote: attacks the nearest creature it can see

lore: Grafted together by a hedge-surgeon who promised two dying brothers one more season, the thing still holds them both and wants only for the other to finally concede who is the better man.

generation.userConcept: two brothers who share one body and argue about who swings
generation.cite: composition after Fire Giant (CR 9) — the giant ladder continues

monsterDescription: two brothers who share one body and argue about who swings
